dct_description_sm: The objectives of this project are: 1) to continue measuring levels and trends of persistent organic pollutants (POPs) in Canadian arctic air, zooplankton and water; 2) to develop a passive water monitoring program for POPs in the Beaufort Sea 3) to screen for new and emerging compounds of concern in the Canadian arctic and 4) screen for occurrence of microplastics in arctic sediment and water.
